gap.behavioural_impact: In a period format EDOPro refuses to resolve the Des Gardius Trigger onto a face-down opponent monster (or onto a monster its controller owns) and exposes the choice to targeting protection and to target-removal responses, none of which constrains the era's non-targeting "equip ... to 1 monster on the field" effect.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (SBCB-EN107, Speed Duel: Battle City Box)

event.historical_text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 2 monsters, including at least 1 "Grand Tiki Elder" or "Melchid the Four-Face Beast". When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, equip 1 "The Mask of Remnants" from your Deck to 1 monster on the field.
event.modern_text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 2 monsters, including at least 1 "Grand Tiki Elder" or "Melchid the Four-Face Beast". If this card is sent from the field to your GY: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip 1 "The Mask of Remnants" from your Deck to it.
event.summary: Functional erratum on two points. (1) Summoning: the era text "This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 2 monsters, including at least 1 \"Grand Tiki Elder\" or \"Melchid the Four-Face Beast\"" is a strict nomi with no source zone, so Des Gardius can never be revived; the errata'd "Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing ..." is semi-nomi and hand-bound, so the modern card may afterwards be Special Summoned from the Graveyard by generic means. (2) The send-off Trigger: the era text equips "The Mask of Remnants" from the Deck "to 1 monster on the field" - any monster, either side, chosen on resolution and not targeted - while the errata'd text reads "Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip 1 \"The Mask of Remnants\" from your Deck to it", which targets on activation and restricts the recipient to a face-up opponent's monster.

rulings_check.difference: The era text is a strict 'cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing' condition, so Des Gardius can never be Special Summoned again from the Graveyard; the modern 'Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand)' text lets it be revived by generic effects afterwards. The era trigger names no target: the equipped monster is chosen on resolution; the modern trigger targets 1 monster when it activates (so target-removal responses and targeting protection apply). The era trigger can equip the Mask to any monster on the field, either side; the modern trigger equips only to a monster your opponent controls. The era trigger can equip a face-down monster; the modern trigger needs a face-up monster.
